Rust dependency closure for CamelPlayer v2 through rust/symphonia_ffi (from rust/Cargo.lock).
Symphonia is MPL-2.0 (full text in MPL-2.0.txt; source: https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia).
The other crates use their MIT license option; encoding_rs additionally requires its WHATWG BSD-3-Clause notice. Full notices are preserved in the rust subdirectories. rustversion is a build-time procedural macro.

bitflags 1.3.2  (MIT/Apache-2.0)  https://github.com/bitflags/bitflags

core_detect 1.0.0  (MIT/Apache-2.0)  https://github.com/thomcc/core_detect
encoding_rs 0.8.42  ((Apache-2.0 OR MIT) AND BSD-3-Clause)  https://github.com/hsivonen/encoding_rs
extended 0.1.0  (MIT)  https://github.com/depp/extended-rs
